verdict.rationale: Rendering and reactivity strategy is a fair question for a React-based web framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a compiler that turns components into surgical DOM updates. The only compiler mention says Next.js auto-configures bundlers and compilers, which is a tooling feature and not this reactivity capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a compiler to translate my components into efficient, surgical DOM updates instead of writing manual diffing code
